Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.portfolio

Class PortfolioHistoryService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.portfolio.PortfolioHistoryService
@Service public class PortfolioHistoryService extends Object
Values the authenticated client's portfolio over a time range.

The walk runs backwards from what is known exactly - today's holdings and cash - undoing each position movement and cash ledger entry as the timeline passes it. Walking back rather than replaying forward from zero means holdings and cash that predate the ledgers (seeded positions, opening balances) are still counted, as held for the whole range. Each holding is priced from market data candles at that point, carrying the last close forward over gaps; the final point is "now", priced at the live price so the chart ends on the value the rest of the dashboard shows.

Deposits and withdrawals move the value without being a gain or loss, so the change over the range leaves them out.

A range keeps its whole span even when the accounts opened part way through it. Up to when they were first funded, each point holds the value they were funded with, flagged, so the chart leads in flat rather than climbing from nothing, and the change counts from then.

Each point carries the market session it falls in. Intraday ranges skip the points that fall while the market is closed, so a Monday morning's 1D chart isn't mostly a flat weekend; 1D also skips the previous day's after-hours, drawing today from its pre-market open against the previous close.

A pre-market pinned for a demo is charted as a new trading day that began when the pin did, whatever the calendar says: its hours trade in pre-market (then the regular session, if the pin ends), and the day's sessions are laid out from it.

  • Method Details

    • getHistory

      public PortfolioHistoryResponse getHistory(PortfolioRange range, UUID accountId)
      Values one of the authenticated client's accounts across the range, or every active account combined when no account is given. Accounts are summed in their base currencies without conversion.
      Parameters:
      range - the range to chart
      accountId - the account to chart, or null for all of them
      Returns:
      the value at each point of the range
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - 404 if the account isn't the client's, 400 if it isn't active
      QuoteUnavailableException - if market data could not be reached
